LanguageData.IAG_Setting_ForesightDesc: When disabled, the divine foresight miracle cannot be used and threats are never delayed by prophecies.
LanguageData.IAG_NoTier: You have no followers. A god without believers has no power.
LanguageData.IAG_FaithTip: Faith is offered by your followers: a little every day from their devotion, more when they pray at a divine shrine, and much more when they hold rituals of your ideoligion.\n\nThe maximum grows with your tier and your number of followers.
LanguageData.IAG_FollowersTip: Colonists who believe in your colony's primary ideoligion. Slaves count as half a follower.
LanguageData.IAG_PassiveFaithTip: Faith offered every day without prayer, proportional to the certainty of your followers. Prayer and rituals add more.
LanguageData.IAG_StrainTip: Every miracle adds 1 strain, which fades by 0.5 per day. Each point of strain makes miracles 15% more expensive.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphetTip: Great miracles are channeled through your prophet: the moral guide of your ideoligion, or its leader if there is no moral guide. Channeling strains the prophet, who cannot channel again while overwhelmed.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoIdeo: Your colony has no ideoligion to be the god of. This mod requires the Ideology DLC.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoProphet: You have no prophet to channel this miracle. Assign a moral guide or leader in your ideoligion.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetIncapable: {PROPHET_labelShort} is in no state to channel a miracle.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetNotHere: {PROPHET_labelShort} must be on this map to channel the miracle.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ProphetOverwhelmed: {PROPHET_labelShort} is overwhelmed by divine power and must rest first.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_Fogged: You cannot work miracles where your people cannot see.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetColonyPawn: Must target a member of the colony or a prisoner.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetFollower: Must target one of your followers.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoCrops: There are no growing crops there.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoEnemies: There are no enemies there to terrify.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_MustTargetCorpse: Must target the body of a dead person.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NotABeliever: {PAWN_labelShort} did not believe in you in life.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_Dessicated: The body is too far gone.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ForesightDisabled: Divine foresight is disabled in the mod settings.
LanguageData.IAG_ForesightText: Your eyes open upon the threads of fate. For the next {0}, every threat sent against your colony will be revealed to you {1} before it arrives.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphecyText: A vision comes to you: {0} will befall {1} in about {2}.\n\nPrepare your people.
LanguageData.IAG_MendDone: The wounds of {PAWN_labelShort} close under a divine touch.
LanguageData.IAG_TerrorReason: Saw the true face of a god.
LanguageData.IAG_ResurrectDone: {PAWN_labelShort} has been called back from beyond!
LanguageData.IAG_IncarnationText: You descend into the flesh of {PAWN_labelShort}. For one day, your faithful will see their god walk among them.
LanguageData.IAG_ConvertedByMiracle: Having witnessed a miracle, {PAWN_labelShort} has converted to {1}.
LanguageData.IAG_Setting_FaithCrisisDesc: When enabled, the colony's doubt rises and falls with events. High doubt weakens the god, saddens believers and can turn them into heretics.
LanguageData.IAG_Setting_RivalActivityDesc: How often hostile rival gods intervene against your colony and bless champions in their raids. At "off" rival gods still exist and can be humbled, but never act.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphecyArrivalWalk: They will come on foot from {0}.
LanguageData.IAG_ProphecyChampion: A champion blessed by {0} leads them.
LanguageData.IAG_NoPropheciesYet: Your eyes are open, but no threat approaches yet.
LanguageData.IAG_NoForesight: Work the divine foresight miracle to see what is coming.
LanguageData.IAG_RivalProphecyText:
A vision comes to you: {0} is preparing {1} against {2}. It will strike in about {3}.
Humble this god before then and its curse will be repelled.
LanguageData.IAG_DoubtTip:
Doubt rises when believers die (more for the prophet), rituals go poorly, heretics live among the faithful, rival gods whisper, and when you hoard faith while staying silent. It falls slowly over time, and faster with miracles, fulfilled prophecies, good rituals, prayer and divine revelation.
25+: murmurs of doubt. 50+: crisis of faith. 75+: schism.
LanguageData.IAG_DoubtEffects_Murmurs: Daily devotion -25%. Believers are slightly unhappy.
LanguageData.IAG_DoubtEffects_Crisis: Daily devotion -50%, prayer -25%. Believers lose certainty and may fall into heresy.
LanguageData.IAG_DoubtEffects_Schism: Daily devotion -75%, prayer -50%. Believers lose certainty quickly and heresy spreads.
LanguageData.IAG_GodSilent: Your believers wonder why you stay silent.
LanguageData.IAG_GodSilentTip: Your faith is nearly full and you have worked no miracle for 3 days. Doubt grows while you hoard their offerings.
LanguageData.IAG_HeresyText:
{PAWN_labelShort} has turned away from you and now worships {1}, following the ideoligion {2}.
Heretics spread doubt among the faithful and may try to convert others. You can win {PAWN_objective} back through conversion, a divine revelation, or deal with {PAWN_objective} as you see fit.
LanguageData.IAG_RevelationText: Your prophet speaks with your voice, and the faithful listen. Every believer grows {0} more certain and the colony's doubt falls by {1}.
LanguageData.IAG_RivalsIntro: The gods of other factions' ideoligions. They grow stronger with the settlements that worship them. Gods of factions hostile to you may curse your colony and bless champions to lead their raids. Slay their champions, or have your prophet humble them, to weaken them.
LanguageData.IAG_RivalsDisabled: Rival god activity is turned off in the mod settings. Rival gods exist, but never act against you.
LanguageData.IAG_RivalPowerTip: A rival god's power grows every day with the settlements that worship it. Power 150+: curses of blight. 250+: wrathful storms. 300+: champions in raids. 450+: seeds of heresy.
LanguageData.IAG_RivalHumbled: humbled, your colony is warded for {0}
LanguageData.IAG_RivalChampionChance: {0} chance of a champion in its raids
LanguageData.IAG_Rival_Repelled: Your ward repels the {1} of {0}. Its power wanes.
LanguageData.IAG_Rival_WhispersText:
{0} whispers to your believers in their dreams, telling them that you are weak and their prayers go unheard.
The colony's doubt rises by {1} and every believer grows a little less certain.
LanguageData.IAG_ChampionArrives: {PAWN_labelShort} leads the raid as a champion of {1}. Slay {PAWN_objective} to humble that god.
LanguageData.IAG_ChampionSlainText: {PAWN_labelShort}, champion of {1}, has fallen. The false god is humbled, and your believers rejoice.
LanguageData.IAG_ChallengeText: Your prophet confronts {0} in your name and prevails. The rival god loses {1} power, and for {2} its curses cannot touch your colony and no champion of it will lead a raid.
LanguageData.IAG_ChoosePathTitle: What kind of god are you?
LanguageData.IAG_ChoosePathIntro: Choose your path once and for all, then the first domain you rule. As your divinity grows you may embrace more domains of the same path (a second at tier 2, a third at tier 4).
LanguageData.IAG_EmbraceIntro: Your divinity has grown. Choose another domain of your path to rule.
LanguageData.IAG_DomainEmbraced: You have embraced the domain of {0}.
LanguageData.IAG_NewDomainSlotText: Your divinity has grown enough to rule another domain. Embrace it from the Domains page of the divinity tab.
LanguageData.IAG_NoPathYet: You have not yet chosen what kind of god you are.
LanguageData.IAG_DivinePointsTip: Divine points unlock miracles in your domain trees. You gain them as you reach higher tiers (2 at tier 1, 4 at tier 2, 7 at tier 3, 10 at tier 4) and one for every 1000 faith ever offered (up to 10 more). A miracle costs 1, 2 or 3 points by row, and needs any one miracle of the row above.
LanguageData.IAG_NextBonusPoint: Next point in {0} more faith offered.
LanguageData.IAG_Node_DomainNotEmbraced: You do not rule the domain of {0}.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_PowerNotUnlocked: Unlock this miracle in your domain tree first.
LanguageData.IAG_AscensionText: {PAWN_labelShort} has been raised into a demigod!\n\nEvery skill +8, mood +30, little pain, half damage taken, armored skin and quick healing. As {PAWN_pronoun} grows in level, {PAWN_pronoun} can learn divine abilities from your domains in the Demigods page of the divinity tab. Those abilities draw on your faith.
LanguageData.IAG_DemigodHint: Raise a follower with at least {0} certainty using the Ascension miracle. You may have as many demigods as your tier.
LanguageData.IAG_DemigodXpTip: Divine experience {0} / {1}.\n\nDemigods grow with time, with the faith their deeds offer, and with the faith they spend. Each level gives one point.
LanguageData.IAG_DemigodFallenText: {PAWN_labelShort}, your demigod, is dead. Your faithful are shaken.
LanguageData.IAG_DemigodLostText: {PAWN_labelShort} no longer serves you, and has lost {PAWN_possessive} divine gifts.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_CertaintyTooLow: {PAWN_labelShort} needs at least {1} certainty to ascend.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_TooManyDemigods: You can have at most {0} demigods at your tier.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NotDemigod: Only a demigod can use this.
LanguageData.IAG_Effect_BountyMap: +{0} growth to every crop on the map
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoOneAffected: No one there would be affected.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_Roofed: The sky must be open above the target.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoGround: There is no poor ground there to enrich.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoFrames: No construction there has all its materials.
LanguageData.IAG_RespecTip: Forget every miracle you have unlocked and get all your divine points back.
LanguageData.IAG_ConfirmRespec: Forget every unlocked miracle and regain your divine points, for {0} faith?
LanguageData.IAG_RespecDone: Your miracles are forgotten and your divine points returned.
LanguageData.IAG_ConfirmDemigodReset: Make {PAWN_labelShort} forget every ability and regain the points, for {1} faith?
LanguageData.IAG_RelicTip: Forge a legendary divine blade for this demigod: a sunblade for a god of creation, a bloodblade for a god of chaos. Once per demigod.
LanguageData.IAG_RelicText: A blade of divine making falls before {PAWN_labelShort}: {1}.
LanguageData.IAG_NoPetitions: No one is praying for anything right now.
LanguageData.IAG_Petition_Food: "Our stores are empty. Feed your children." ({0})
LanguageData.IAG_Petition_Sign: "Are you there? Show us a sign." ({0})
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionHint_Healing: Answer with a healing miracle on them: mending touch, cure, healing light, restoration.
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionHint_Food: Answer with a miracle that brings food: manna from heaven, gift of the fields.
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionHint_Protection: Answer with a miracle against the enemy: smite, terror, explosions, curses.
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionHint_Sign: Answer by letting them witness any miracle.
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionHint_Weather: Answer with clear skies or a change of weather.
LanguageData.IAG_PetitionAnswered: You answered the prayer of {PAWN_labelShort}. +{1} faith.
LanguageData.IAG_CommandmentIntro: Lay a commandment on your followers for a few days. Keep it and they are rewarded; break or fail it and they doubt. One at a time, five days apart.
LanguageData.IAG_CommandmentKeptText: Your followers kept the commandment of {0}. They offer you {1} faith and their faith grows.
LanguageData.IAG_CommandmentBrokenText: Your followers failed the commandment of {0}. Doubt spreads among them.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_CommandmentActive: A commandment is already in force.
LanguageData.IAG_HolyDaysIntro: On the holy day of each of your domains, rituals offer twice the faith, prayer half again as much, and your believers celebrate.
LanguageData.IAG_HolyDayText: Today is the {0}, the holy day of your domain of {1}.\n\nRituals offer twice the faith today, prayer half again as much, and your believers celebrate.
LanguageData.IAG_OfferSacrificeDesc: Choose a prisoner or one of the colony's animals to sacrifice to your god. Your prophet, or another follower, performs the rite.
LanguageData.IAG_NoVictims: There is no one to sacrifice.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoSacrificer: No follower here is able to perform the rite.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_ChaosOnly: Only a god of the path of chaos accepts blood sacrifice.
LanguageData.IAG_NoMessengers: No great messenger walks the mortal world. At tier 3 the prophet can call down your god's messenger: a Seraphim for the path of Creation, Tiamat for the path of Chaos.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerLineAvatar: {0}: avatar of {1}, come to destroy you
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerFell: {0} has fallen and returns to the heavens.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerAutoCastDesc: When on, the messenger uses its skills on its own whenever they are worth it. Turn off to use them only when you order.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerGuardDesc: Send the messenger to a place to guard it. It fights only enemies that come near its post.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerRoamDesc: Leave the post and hunt down every enemy on the map.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerAttackDesc: Order the messenger to attack a target.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerDismissDesc: Dismiss the messenger now. It leaves the mortal world at once.
LanguageData.IAG_MessengerArrivedText:
Your god has heard the prophet and sent its messenger: the {0} now walks the mortal world to fight for the colony. It stays for {1}.
It fights on its own. Select it to command it: order its skills, set it to guard a place or to fight freely, order an attack, or send it back early.
LanguageData.IAG_AvatarText:
{0} has grown so mighty that it no longer works through omens: it has sent its avatar, in the form of {1}, to destroy your colony, and the faithful of {2} march with it.
Slay the avatar to humble {0} for many days. Your own god's messenger can fight it.
LanguageData.IAG_AvatarSlainText:
The avatar of {0} has fallen. Your believers rejoice: their god is the true one.
+{1} faith. {0} loses much of its power and is humbled for {2} days.
LanguageData.IAG_MissionsIntro: Send a caravan with believers to a friendly or neutral settlement and choose "Preach the faith". After two days of preaching the settlement may come closer to your god. A converted settlement offers faith every day and no longer feeds its old god; when half a faction's settlements believe, the whole faction takes your ideoligion.
LanguageData.IAG_PreachDesc:
The believers in this caravan preach the word of your god here for {0} days. The caravan must stay until they finish.
Chance of success: {1}. It grows with the missionaries' social skill and number, your god's tier, a demigod or the prophet among them, and the hosts' goodwill; a strong rival god makes it harder.
LanguageData.IAG_Reason_NoMissionary: No believer in the caravan can preach.
LanguageData.IAG_MissionStarted: {0} begins preaching in {1}. It must stay for {2} days.
LanguageData.IAG_MissionSuccessText:
The people of {0} listened to your missionaries. {1} of them now believe in your god.
+{2} faith.
LanguageData.IAG_MissionFailed: The people of {0} would not listen to your missionaries.
LanguageData.IAG_MissionDisasterText: The people of {0} took offence at your missionaries. {PAWN_labelShort} was beaten before the caravan was driven off, and the faction thinks less of you.
LanguageData.IAG_SettlementConvertedText: The people of {0} have embraced your god. Though they remain of {1}, they now pray to your god (+{2} faith per day) and no longer feed their old god.
LanguageData.IAG_FactionConvertedText: So many of their settlements have turned to your god that {0} has abandoned {1} and taken {2} as its own ideoligion.
